name: Mi Crush Victoriano
source:
Welcome to Strawberry Manor! In this visual novel developed by María Pinku, you will step into the shoes of Issy (she/her), Jamey (he/him), or Alex (they/them), who has just arrived at Lord Wentworth’s manor to work.

There, you will meet various members of the Wentworth family, as well as the manor’s staff. Each person has their own interests and secrets, you choose whom you want to get to know better and, depending on the decisions you make the story could lead to a happy ending where you forge a friendship with your chosen character or... perhaps something more.

[Translated from [url=https://mariapinku.itch.io/mi-crush-victoriano-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
